messages:
gina_pm: Heads-up - CSMs want a tighter pilot plan for the Optimize toolkit: they need clear acceptance criteria, minimal infra risk, and a straightforward rollback. Can we map out a 4-week field pilot that covers eval-alerts + per-tenant batching recs + conservative quant suggestions?

emily_csm: Customers prefer passive suggestions (UI/email) first. Theydont want automated toggles enabled without a review. 3 pilot tenants: marketplace SaaS, ecommerce search, fintech summaries.

rahul_eng: Implementation constraints: we should avoid touching the hot path. Option A: offline analysis job that consumes a sampled event stream (1% sampling) and writes recs to advisor DB. Option B: lightweight streaming probe that reads request metadata only. I vote Option A for safety.

marc_ops: Agree on offline. Requirements: logs must be sanitized, tenant IDs hashed, retention 21 days for pilot. Also add an incident playbook section  runbook:optimize-advisor-pilot  with revert knobs.

ash (feature-bot): Reminder: toggle created 'optimize-advisor-pilot-mode' in staging.

gina_pm: Pilot success metrics (must):
- at least 2 actionable recs per tenant in 2 weeks
- first real eval-alert validated by CSM within 48h
- no automated degradation after applying recs (measured by post-change eval on heldout)
Nice-to-have: webhook for accepted recs to autopopulate change requests.

rahul_eng: For batching recs we'll compute: observed request QPS, median/95th token length, prefix_reuse, and cost delta estimates for batch sizes {1,4,8,16}. Recommender picks smallest batch size with predicted p95 < tenant_slo and cost improvement > 8%. Example rule text wed emit in UI: "Try batch_size=8 during off-peak; expect ~12% token cost reduction."

tori_research: Eval-alert logic: maintain per-tenant prompt-set baselines (BLEU/ROUGE is noisy for many customers; use concordance + classifier-based drift). Trigger when classifier probability drop > 10% over 500 recent requests OR concordance delta > 0.1. Include example diff snippets in the alert for triage.

emily_csm: Important: alerts must surface a short explanation and recommended next steps, e.g., "restore previous model variant" or "reject quantization for this prompt-set". Also attach sample payloads (anonymized).

marc_ops: On-call: alerts should default to P2 for the pilot, escalate to P1 only if production error rate > 1% or latency > 2x baseline. Include a one-click revert link that creates a rollback PR (manual approval required).

rahul_eng: Quantization guidance: only recommend quantization-level when simulated quant eval vs baseline shows metric loss < 0.05 and cost < baseline by >15%. Otherwise show "try simulated quantization in staging" suggestion. No auto-rollouts for quant during pilot.

gina_pm: Launch gates for go/no-go decision:
1) data contract spec published and accepted by security (fields + sampling + retention)
2) offline advisor runs for 72h with synthetic + internal tenant data; signal completeness > 98%
3) at least one validated alert + one batching rec accepted by a pilot tenant
4) runbook + revert flows tested in staging

rahul_eng: Proposed timeline: Week 0: data contract + infra setup; Week 1: offline runs + triangulation; Week 2: onboard tenant A read-only; Week 3: tenant B+C join; Week 4: measure acceptance rates & decide.

tori_research: Risk notes: small sample sizes per tenant can make alerts noisy. Mitigation: require multi-window confirmation (e.g., 2 windows of 250 samples) before surfacing high-severity alerts. Also add a confidence score to each rec.

emily_csm: Customer comms draft idea: "Were piloting Optimize Advisor to suggest batching/caching changes and flagging quality regressions. We will not change live behavior without your approval." Will share text.

gina_pm: Action items: @rahul_eng write data contract doc (fields + hash scheme + sampling) by EOD Tue; @tori_research write eval-alert thresholds + example alert payloads by Wed; @marc_ops create pilot runbook checklist + revert templates by Fri. Next sync Monday 10am.

feature-bot: Note: created task list in /projects/optimize-field-pilot with auto-reminders. :white_check_mark:
